definition_and_cause: The requested person is replaced by a different name absent from the supplied gold aliases. Incorrect entity association or title ambiguity.
The predicted occupation or genre differs from the benchmark attribute rather than being a broader version of it.
The response supplies a different country or administrative level inconsistent with the benchmark answer.
The output is a broader category related to a supplied gold alias but lacks the benchmark's specificity.
A shortened or closely related lexical form is absent from the supplied alias list.
The response gives a real-world occupation of a multi-occupation entity that is absent from the Wikidata-derived gold alias list.
